svg.text: Figure 12. Polishing every orbit: Newton steps on half a lap, in 34-digit arithmetic
how far the half-lap mirror test misses
A. Each line is one orbit. Each quad step roughly doubles the correct digits,
B. Grey: best double precision can do (8 to 14 digits). Coloured: polished,
all 66 orbits close to 26 to 32 digits.
